..Title
Resolution to Approve Amendment No. 3 to the Parking Agreement between the City of Ann Arbor and the Ann Arbor Downtown Development Authority
..Memorandum
This resolution approves an amendment to the Parking Agreement between the City and Downtown Development Authority (DDA) to replace the requirement of a joint annual working session of both the DDA and City Council with a more flexible consultation process allowing either a joint session or staff consultation.

The DDA Executive Director has reviewed the proposed amendment and will recommend that the DDA Board adopt it.

City Administration recommends approval of the amendment.
..Staff
Prepared by:   	Christopher Frost, Senior Assistant City Attorney
Approved by:		Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
RESOLVED, That City Council approves the attached Amendment No. 3 to the Parking Agreement;

RESOLVED, That the Mayor and City Clerk are authorized and directed to execute Amendment No. 3 to the Parking Agreement after approval by the DDA Board and by the City Administrator and City Attorney; and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator is authorized to take all appropriate actions to implement this resolution.
